tasks.short: Inform students about community arts events

steps.what: Select relevant community plays, concerts and other events
Compile event dates, venues and access information into a student notice
Check current event details and keep students informed

tasks.design: Use a native {LMS} notice template to format teacher-selected event details from a small form. Keep event selection and final checks against organiser information with the teacher; no model chooses events or invents access details.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dates, locations and links are copied into differently formatted notices.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed fields and a reusable notice layout remove repeated formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Events can change, sell out or lack reliable accessibility information.
tasks.human_edge: Choose events that broaden students' artistic experience and fit their circumstances.
tasks.altitude: Less notice formatting; event selection and publication responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Event access details and organiser verification

evidence.claim: A fixed notice template can reduce formatting after event details are captured; this is E1 model knowledge, not a measured digest case.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher selection, notice preparation and publication, excluding event booking and student attendance.

The teacher captures title, event type, date, time, venue, organiser link, known cost and verified access information in s1 and retained s2 time; all 35 selection hours and 16 compilation hours remain. Unknown details are labelled unknown or omitted, never inferred.
The teacher rechecks material details in s3. Cancelled events return to manual correction; additional change monitoring is included in upkeep.
Test native notice templates before custom code. Existing automated notices earn no new labour saving.
unknowns: Availability and reliability of organiser information
research_questions: Does a native template reduce formatting after counting field entry and organiser checks?

already_counted.description: Selection, field capture, draft checks and publication

incremental.description: Maintain notice layout and monitor changed event details

approvals.approved_version: Exact notice text, event dates, links, cost and stated access information; edits require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+16+25=76; gross 24%, minus four upkeep gives 20% central net. Low assumes eight formatting hours removable because organiser notices require more manual capture.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees

steps.what: Review committee papers on institutional and departmental academic issues
Discuss institutional policies and academic issues with committee members

tasks.design: Keep committee paper review and deliberation with the teacher using {DOCS}. No separate secretarial task or document-production baseline is attributed to committee participation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Institutional choices require interpreting evidence and negotiating priorities.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing committee papers already support the discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Members can reasonably disagree about educational and departmental priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Bring teaching experience to decisions and engage with competing views.
tasks.altitude: Committee responsibility and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Committee evidence review and deliberation retain all labour in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is this member's preparation and participation; chair and secretary labour remains outside the focal denominator.
No new structured inputs or automated committee decisions are introduced.
Existing native document access is sufficient. No new deployment or upkeep is added, justifying zero incremental work.
research_questions: Which policy choices require the teacher's direct professional contribution?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Preparation judgement and committee discussion are retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Act as advisers to student organizations through discussion and guidance

tasks.design: Keep student-organisation advice with the teacher, supported by institutional guidance in {DOCS}. No automated adviser or new record-making process is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student plans and group relationships require contextual discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing guidance already supports a human adviser.
tasks.still_hard: Advice must support student ownership while identifying practical or welfare concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Help students make their own decisions and recognise when further support is needed.
tasks.altitude: Advisory responsibilities and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Contextual advice to student groups retains its labour without an assumed administrative baseline.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher advice, excluding students' event organisation and separate administrative approval processes.
No automated step relies on new structured student-group data.
Existing native policy access suffices. No new system or process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Student group remit and adviser responsibilities
research_questions: Which student plans need referral to an institutional specialist?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Student advice remains a human conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organise performance groups and direct rehearsals

steps.what: Organize performance groups and agree artistic roles
Arrange rehearsal times, rooms and participant invitations
Direct rehearsals and give practical artistic feedback

tasks.design: Use native {CALENDAR} group availability and room booking to prepare rehearsal invitations. Keep group formation, artistic roles, schedule confirmation and live rehearsal direction with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rehearsal dates and room details are repeatedly compared in messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar views can reduce that comparison when availability is already recorded.
tasks.still_hard: Artistic development and ensemble relationships require live direction.
tasks.human_edge: Hear and see what the group needs, then give useful artistic feedback.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less rehearsal correspondence; artistic direction remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native calendar availability can reduce rehearsal correspondence; this is E1 model knowledge, not a measured arts case.

assumptions: Boundary includes teacher group organisation, scheduling and rehearsal direction, excluding performer practice and performance-coordinator labour.

The teacher produces participant IDs, required roles, rehearsal duration and equipment constraints in s1 and retained s2 time. Existing participants' calendars and room booking transactions supply availability; no new student data-entry duty is required.

Missing availability or unsuitable rooms return to manual discussion within the 7.5 retained s2 hours. Test native group calendars before custom code; only existing reliable calendar coverage supports the scenario.
unknowns: Participant calendar coverage and room booking quality
research_questions: Does calendar comparison save time without new performer capture or reduced artistic discussion?

already_counted.description: Rehearsal constraints, availability checks and invitation confirmation

incremental.description: Maintain group calendar and resolve recurring booking faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact performers, rehearsal date, duration, room and equipment in the invitation; changes require reconfirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+7.5+55=92.5; gross 7.5%, minus two upkeep gives 5.5% central net. Low assumes only three correspondence hours removed; group formation and all rehearsal direction remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less event-notice formatting and rehearsal correspondence, with artistic direction, student advice and committee duties retained.
reach: Work with performance coordinators on practical rehearsal arrangements
role.ambitious_version: An arts teacher who spends less time formatting notices and more time developing students' work.
